contract: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"2 <= n <= 300000","description":"The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 300,000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"n - 1 <= m <= min(300000, (n * (n - 1)) // 2)","description":"The number of edges m must be at least n-1 and at most the minimum of 300,000 and the maximum possible edges for n vertices."},{"id":"P3","expression":"1 <= k <= n","description":"The number of special vertices k must be between 1 and n."},{"id":"P4","expression":"all(1 <= v_i <= n for v_i in special_vertices)","description":"All special vertices must be valid indices between 1 and n."},{"id":"P5","expression":"all(0 <= c_i <= 10**9 for c_i in c)","description":"All vertex profits c_i must be non-negative and at most 1,000,000,000."},{"id":"P6","expression":"all(0 <= w_i <= 10**9 for w_i in w)","description":"All edge costs w_i must be non-negative and at most 1,000,000,000."},{"id":"P7","expression":"all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for x_i, y_i in edges)","description":"All edges must connect valid distinct vertices."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"len(output) == n","description":"The output must contain exactly n integers."},{"
